key: bio:v3:Trent Ltd:Retirement:Noel N. Tata retires as Chairman on 11 Nov 2026; Bahram Vakil appointed Chairman, with two director appointments.

people.name: Noel N. Tata
background: Vice Chairman of Tata Steel and Titan Company
Former Managing Director of Trent Ltd (1999-2010)
Trustee of Sir Dorabji Tata Trust and Sir Ratan Tata Trust

people.name: Bahram Vakil
background: Expert in infrastructure, project finance, and bankruptcy law

value.why_it_matters: This transition marks the end of Noel Tata's long-standing leadership at Trent and introduces a legal and corporate governance expert as Chairman to oversee the company's next growth phase.
